What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

A sovereign stack is a combination of free and paid tools that give digital creators a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This is not a workaround, but base-layer infrastructure designed to empower creators. With a correctly configured sovereign stack, orders can be processed in under 30 seconds, eliminating the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation relies on a webhook pipeline that triggers order fulfillment. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook fires, confirming the payment on-chain and triggering the delivery of the digital product. This process is automated, secure, and efficient, allowing creators to focus on producing high-quality content rather than worrying about payment processing.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators produce high-quality digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software, but struggle to sell them online due to payment processing limitations. The sovereign stack is designed to empower these creators, giving them the tools they need to succeed in the global digital marketplace.
Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of the sovereign stack include Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. These tools are free or low-cost, making them accessible to creators in regions with limited financial resources. With the right combination of these tools, creators can build a robust and efficient online store that processes orders quickly and securely.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign stack today, creators can start by selecting the right combination of tools and configuring them to work together seamlessly. This may involve setting up a Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers backend, integrating NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and configuring Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. With the right guidance and support, creators can have a fully operational online store up and running in a matter of days.
